items.rationale: Retiling of the damaged panel: 2.4 m × 0.85 m wall plus 2.4 m × 0.4 m plinth is about 3 m², so the quantity matches. Indemnified at the installed tiling rate of about 90 €/m² × 3.
One hole through a new tile for the line was necessary for reinstatement. Price prior is about 70 per piece.
Same tile size as before and standard grade, so same kind and quality. 3 m² at a standard-tile material rate of about 35 €/m².
Rebuilding the patch of render that had gone soft to the brick, about 1 m², is part of the repair.
Second tile material line in a non-standard format. It duplicates line 3 and exceeds the damage extent, so it falls under 3.5(a), (d) and (e).
The corner joint (2.4 m) plus the panel end (about 1.25 m) gives about 3.6 m, so the quantity matches. About 10 €/m.
A premium-grade duplicate of the silicone joints in a quantity far beyond the 3.6 m needed. Excluded under 3.5(a), (d) and (e).
First travel charge of the tiler on this document, payable under 7.4.2 at the full rate of about 82.

The tiling and removal work is already priced in unit and flat-rate lines, so labour is not payable again under 7.4.1. Part of the hours also relate to the excluded attic work. If paid, 14 hrs × about 54.
Cleaning of the reinstated surface within the damage area remains a repair cost under 3.5(c).
The meter boxing board was wet along the bottom, so it lies in the damage area. Covered as demolition/opening-up cost.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Wet mineral wool from the boxing was removed and taken away separately from the container waste. Price prior is about 74.
Damp render behind the 3 m² panel was hacked off. This is necessary demolition within the damage area, at about 30 €/m² × 3.
Old staining on the attic gable from the re-felting, unrelated to the cellar leak. Excluded under 3.5(b).
The cover ring cracked when the tiles came off, so replacing it is making good. Standard chrome rosette.

This is resealing the leaking compression joint with a new olive. That is not a fracture, so it is repair of the source rather than water damage; there is some chance it is paid as part of the repair.
Technical drying under 5.2.7, supported by documented readings over about a week, so the 7 days are consistent. About 30 €/day × 7.
Flat surcharge not attributed to specific required materials (7.4.4). Consumables are included in unit prices under 7.4.3.
Replaces the 1 m of sodden lagging. Price prior is about 22 per m.
Container for the tiles, render and board is debris removal under 5.2.1. It is a different removal from the wool in line 12. Price prior is about 60.
